decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed development for the erection of two flats, would lead to the development of an existing garden area, which has been declassified as brownfield space within PPS3 (as amended 2010) Consequently, it is not a suitable location for housing development as defined by PPS3 which requires Local Planning Authorities to make effective use of land by re-using land that has been previously developed.  The principle of the proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and Policy 3.5 of the London Plan.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed creation of  2 residential units is considered to be an excessive development of this small site, with an excessive residential density, resulting in an inadequate standard and layout of residential accommodation for future occupiers, inadequate amenity space provision, problems of parking, and noise and vibration, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, H 4.1, T 1.1 and T 1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan and Policy 3.5 of the London Plan.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The proposed arrangements for vehicular access and parking for the proposed increase in intensity of use of the site are considered to be unsafe and are likely to give rise to conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic on the public highway and increase in danger for traffic and pedestrians, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, T 1.4 and T 4.3 of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 4 - 4.	Inadequate provision is made for improving energy efficiency and increasing the proportion of energy used generated from renewable sources, contrary to policy 5.7 of the London Plan.
description: Construction of a two storey building comprising of a studio flat at ground floor level and a 2-bedroom maisonette on the first and second floor.
